content:
maria: Quick sync — product asks for a token-cost/unit-econ dashboard by EOW. Need runtime + infra inputs: cost per 1K tokens, cache & batching savings breakdowns, and actionable panels. Who can own metrics and data contract?

taylor: I can lead the dashboard UX + panels. Need clear metric definitions and example queries so I can mock panels (per-route, per-model, per-tenant).

seung: From runtime we can emit the following as counters/timeseries: tokens_in, tokens_generated, kv_cache_hits, kv_cache_lookups, batch_size_histogram, model_variant, gpu_ms. Those map to existing endpoints under /metrics/runtime_*. Will add stable label 'tenant_id' and 'route' if platform can attach them.

rashid: Infra side: to translate gpu_ms -> $ we need a rate table ($/GPU-hour by instance family + reserved vs preemptible) and network egress $/GB. Also include storage and infra overhead % for platform services. We can provide a small CSV with rates.

olivia: Finance will publish the unit costs: $/GPU-hour per family, $/GB-egress, and an overhead uplift for ops. We'll also include guidance for margin/transfer pricing so dashboards show infra vs model vs platform cost slices.

nate: DevEx suggestion: sample full token traces for ~1% of requests to measure real cache hit behavior and batching effectiveness; aggregated counters are fine otherwise. Important: do not log full prompts in metrics. Keep traces minimal and hashed tenant IDs.

maria: Proposed canonical metric defs (short):
 - tokens_in: count of input tokens per request
 - tokens_out: count of generated tokens per request
 - cache_hits: number of prefix/KV hits (contributes to saved tokens)
 - batch_saved_tokens: estimated tokens saved due to batching/merging
 - gpu_ms: GPU milliseconds consumed for the request
We should land on these names & labels so dashboards and cost formulas are stable.

seung: SQL draft for a summary panel (will refine once labels are final):
```
SELECT model_variant,
       sum(tokens_out) AS gen_tokens,
       sum(tokens_in) AS in_tokens,
       sum(cache_hits) AS cache_hits,
       avg(batch_size) AS avg_batch_size,
       sum(gpu_ms) AS total_gpu_ms
FROM runtime_events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY model_variant;
```
I'll add tenant_id route_label later.

taylor: Panel list I'm going to build: cost_per_1k_tokens (by model and by tenant), cache_savings_pct, avg_batch_size, cost_trend_7d, unit_econ_waterfall (raw infra cost -> cache savings -> batching -> quantization savings), and top_20 cost drivers by route. Need the cost formula: (gpu_ms * $/gpu_ms) + (egress_GB * $/GB) + platform_overhead.

rashid: Telemetry hooks checklist: runtime must emit model_variant + quant_profile tags; platform must enrich events with tenant_id and route_name; infra must supply a mapping service endpoint for instance_type -> $/ms. We also need a stable enum for model_variant values.

metrics-bot: Quick note: metric naming & labels should follow the styleguide: use snake_case, avoid cardinality explosions (limit label values), and include these tags: model, tenant, route, quant_profile. See /docs/metrics-style for examples.

olivia: Action items & owners: seung -> add runtime metrics + labels (3 days), rashid -> publish cost rate table + enrichment endpoint (2 days), taylor -> dashboard skeleton & mockups (3 days), nate -> sampling plan and privacy guardrails (2 days), maria -> product acceptance criteria + example queries (EOW).

maria: Thanks — calendar invite for Fri 10am PT to review mockups + initial panels. @taylor can you start the mockups and drop links here? :thumbsup:

seung: Will open a PR with metric names and example metrics endpoint this afternoon.

rashid: I'll put the cost CSV into infra-configs S3 and make a small service to serve rates.

nate: I'll draft the sampling playbook and a short privacy checklist for traces.

maria: Perfect. If anyone hits blockers call out here, otherwise we aim to close telemetry + skeleton by EOW.
